We are ODAA (Oh-Dah)!
The Office of Design & Architecture.
We are an exciting, design-focused Architecture and Interiors practice spanning both the commercial and residential sectors based in DTLA. We have a strong collaborative culture that fosters creative energy and design solutions that all team members are a part of. We strive to inspire and support our clients from the beginning to the end of the process.
We are currently seeking a motivated Intermediate to Senior level Architectural Designer lll with a broad range of experience across commercial Architectural and Interiors projects to fulfill a full-time position. We want someone who is excited about design, who wants to be part of a great team, who is eager to learn, who is motivated push themselves, and wants to be part of getting projects built.
We are looking for someone that meets the following:
Professional duties include, participation in the conceptual design and provides full support throughout the entire project. Liaises with clients, project managers, other architects, consultants, and contractors.Develops and represents lead technical viewpoint on projects. Coordinates with the director and department head on appropriate technical solutions and product strategies.
Benefits. Salary is commensurate with education level, professional experience, and demonstrated knowledge. ODAA offers competitive benefits including a flexible Health plan and IRA with company matching, as well as two weeks of paid vacation, including end-of-year office closure between Christmas and New Year, paid holidays and sick leave, and paid DTLA parking. ODAA also supports licensure and continuing education.
Remote. Currently, ODAA offers remote access every Friday. The remainder of the week is expected to be in person in our studio in DTLA.
ODAA is an Equal-opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, national origin, gender, gender expression, religion, ethnic background, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Please submit your resume, portfolio samples, salary requirements, and confirmation of eligibility to work in the US to: [email protected].
